title: unified-rollouts: add canary + A/B + shadow traffic automated rollback workflow
author: Priya Raman
description: Context: We need a single, opinionated rollout controller that supports progressive canary, A/B experiments, and shadow probing while providing a safe automated rollback path when model/regression signals exceed thresholds. This PR implements the controller-side orchestration, exposes new rollout policy fields in the API/CRD, adds matching observability metrics/alerts, and includes end-to-end tests and console UI changes. Goals: 1) Enable canary/A-B/shadow in a single rollout resource and API. 2) Add deterministic metric-driven auto-rollback with multi-metric matching and safety guards. 3) Improve observability (per-variant SLOs, delta metrics) so SREs can tune thresholds. What changed: - rollout controller: scheduling state machine for staged canary->weighted rollout->stable with shadow probing and automatic rollback triggers. - policy schema: new fields rollout.policy.strategy, rollout.policy.metrics, rollout.policy.safetyGuards, rollout.policy.probing.windowMs. Backwards-compatible defaults provided. - observability: per-variant request/error/latency metrics, composite delta metrics (p90_delta, error_rate_delta) and alert rules. - console: UI to configure multi-metric rollback rules and visualize staged shadow probes. - tests: unit coverage for controller transitions, integration e2e simulating metric regressions and validating rollback behavior. - docs: rollout reference and migration notes. Checklist: - [x] Controller implementation - [x] API/schema changes with migration notes - [x] Integration/e2e tests - [x] Console changes and snapshots - [x] Observability dashboards and alerts - [x] Documentation and linear links - [x] QA signoff Impact/risk: introduces a new policy surface but defaults to conservative safe behavior (no auto-rollback unless thresholds provided). We added safety guards: minTrafficBeforeRollback, coolDownWindowMs, and composite-metric matcher to avoid noisy signals. Related: ENG-1982 (unified rollout design), ENG-2041 (rollback safety guards), SUP-4312 (customer incident prompting shadow probing).
commits: 5 commits: 1) add rollout policy schema + defaults; 2) implement state machine + rollback handler; 3) observability metrics + alerts; 4) console UI + snapshots; 5) e2e tests and docs

--- a/redwood/pkg/rollout/controller.go
+++ b/redwood/pkg/rollout/controller.go
@@ -120,6 +120,32 @@ func reconcile(...) {
+ // handle staged canary -> weighted -> stable transitions
+ if policy.Strategy == "staged" {
+    // schedule probe to shadow variant and evaluate metrics
+    scheduleShadowProbe(...)
+ }
--- a/redwood/pkg/rollout/policy.go
+++ b/redwood/pkg/rollout/policy.go
@@ -10,6 +10,22 @@ type RolloutPolicy struct {
+ Strategy string `json:"strategy"` // canary|ab|staged
+ Metrics []MetricRule `json:"metrics"` // list of metric matchers for rollback
+ SafetyGuards SafetyConfig `json:"safetyGuards"`
--- a/redwood/observability/alerts/rollout_alerts.yaml
+++ b/redwood/observability/alerts/rollout_alerts.yaml
@@ -1,3 +1,12 @@

+   for: 2m
review_comments: Nikhil Rao: Overall design looks good, left nits around state transitions and a suggestion to add a cooldown hook before auto-rollback.
Elena Park: Can you add an e2e test that simulates noisy telemetry (flapping) to ensure the composite matcher tolerates bursts?
Priya Raman: Added flapping test in e2e/rollouts_test.go and introduced coolDownWindowMs to avoid immediate rollback on spikes.
Samir Patel: Verified metrics are tagged with rollout_id and variant; reduced cardinality where possible. Approved after CI fixed two flaky console snapshots.
release_notes: Adds unified rollout controller with staged canary/A-B/shadow support and configurable automated rollback policies. Includes observability metrics and alerts, console UI for policy config, and e2e tests. Backwards-compatible defaults (no auto-rollback).
